About the project

Independent talent should not mean growing alone.

Across Europe, young freelancers are creative and flexible, yet many lack the mentoring, business skills, and access to funding needed to grow. At the same time, NEET youth, migrants, and young people with fewer opportunities often face an unclear path into work.

SHIFT connects these realities — creating a practical bridge from self-employment to sustainable entrepreneurship.

01 / WHY

Build the bridge

Accessible, practical education helps young people turn an existing skill, freelance activity, or early idea into a viable business.

→

02 / HOW

Learn by doing

Digital tools, non-formal learning, teamwork, mentoring, and real startup practice make the transition tangible.

→

03 / IMPACT

Grow together

A cross-border network connects young founders, youth workers, educators, and entrepreneurship ecosystems.

→

F2S

Learning platform

Five modules to move from freelancer to founder.

The open-access Freelancer-to-Startup Toolkit combines step-by-step guidance, exercises, and methods that youth workers can use in practice. It will be available in English, Slovenian, Lithuanian, and Portuguese.

01

Business model & value proposition

Clarify the customer, the problem, and the unique value behind the idea.

↗
02

Lean startup & digital innovation

Test assumptions, learn quickly, and use digital tools to build smarter.

↗
03

Financial literacy & funding

Understand costs, revenue, cash flow, and routes to financing.

↗
04

Growth & business development

Design sustainable growth through customers, partnerships, and focus.

↗
05

Leadership, networks & mindset

Build the confidence and relationships needed to lead a young venture.

↗
Open educational resource

Practical by design. Open for long-term impact.

The toolkit is co-created, peer-reviewed, tested through national bootcamps, and designed to remain available after the project ends.
